start: Workout tab, member whose plan ends in 3 days, no renewal on record, the Gym tab opened earlier

user_sees: Small card 'Your plan ends on <Day>, <date>. Renew at the front desk.'
must_not: The card for a plan that ends in more than 7 days
A day name without the date

user_sees: The Gym tab opens with 'My membership'

start: Workout tab, member with nothing kept on the phone

steps.action: Open the Workout tab when the Gym tab was never opened, or the gym does not keep plans
must_not: A card with an empty date
An error on the Workout tab

start: Workout tab, member who renews at the desk while the card shows

steps.action: Desk renews; member opens the Workout tab again
user_sees: The card is gone (the gym is asked again when the kept plan ends soon)
must_not: The card still telling a renewed member to renew

user_sees: 'Your plan ends today. Renew at the front desk.'

start: Workout tab on a phone a pass member uses

user_sees: No card for a pass member, even with an old plan still running
must_not: A renew nudge to a pass member
